tbesh_html:
1) to lack, be without, decrease, be lacking, have a need
1a) (Qal)
1a1) to lack
1a2) to be lacking
1a3) to diminish, decrease
1b) (Piel) to cause to lack
1c) (Hiphil) to cause to be lacking

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to lack; by implication, to fail, want, lessen
strongs_1890.kjv_def: be abated, bereave, decrease, (cause to) fail, (have) lack, make lower, want.
